component_swaps.declaration: derived per INTRA_WEIGHTS['E'] = {E1 0.55, E2 0.45}. E2 ONLY is present, so E = E2 exactly and nothing is scaled. E2 = value added at sub-national accounts, `implemented` per doctrine/METRIC_REGISTRY.yaml, licensed as a composition by D-13 (2 October 2026). E1 (ARERA penalties per LV user) is DECLARED ABSENT: it is published for italy alone. Intra-coverage 0.45 is declared on every record as _E_coverage and rolled up into composite_coverage_intra, because composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21 and would otherwise credit E's full 0.10 silently. The sweep (doctrine/EVIDENCE_provenance_sweep_20261005.json) records metrics.E2 and metrics._E2_raw as FABRICATED on no fleet.
component_swaps.note: components.E swapped from the name hash to its own stored metrics. No band, score or _cprov touched here; the rescore and the re-emission of _cprov and composite_coverage follow in their own instruments.

component_swaps.declaration: derived per INTRA_WEIGHTS['I'] over the metrics this fleet carries: I1,I2,I3,I4,I5,I6, intra-coverage 0.72, renormalised over the present set. I7,I8,I9 are DECLARED ABSENT. I7, I8 and I9 are stored on NO record in the estate. Every present metric is `implemented` in doctrine/METRIC_REGISTRY.yaml and entered in doctrine/METRIC_PROVENANCE.yaml (P15-M-1). The sweep (doctrine/EVIDENCE_provenance_sweep_20261005.json) records none of them nor their raw inputs as FABRICATED on this fleet, while components.I IS fabricated here -- so this replaces a name hash with measurements. Intra-coverage is declared on every record as _I_coverage and rolled into composite_coverage_intra, because composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21 and would otherwise credit I's full 0.25 silently. The 0.45 floor is the flag officer's D-16 ruling of 5 October 2026.
component_swaps.note: components.I swapped from the name hash to its own stored metrics. No band, score or _cprov touched here; the rescore and the re-emission of _cprov and composite_coverage follow in their own instruments.

component_swaps.declaration: derived per INTRA_WEIGHTS['C'] = {C1 0.40, C2 0.30, C3 0.15, C4 0.15} over the ONE metric this fleet carries, intra-coverage 0.40, renormalised over the present set, so C = C1. C1 = SAIDI_EnWG in minutes per year, the publisher's own unit, from Bundesnetzagentur, 'Bundeslaender-SAIDIsEnWG seit 2008', TabelleBL.xlsx, sheet 'Bundeslaender', column 2024, read at full precision from the workbook rather than from any rounded republication. 88,424 bytes, sha256 2cc5a2b08656a6d2. Frozen as data/c_metrics/germany.csv; written into `metrics` by scripts/ssi_persist_metrics_C_germany.py, Method B UNIT-weighted over germany's own sixteen Bundeslaender -- unit-weighted and not record-weighted because bayern alone carries 23,619 of the 106,053 and record-weighting makes the two extremes the same number. ATTRIBUTION, AS THE LICENCE OBLIGES: Datenquelle Bundesnetzagentur, 'Bundeslaender-SAIDIsEnWG seit 2008', Datenlizenz Deutschland - Namensnennung - Version 4.0. The publisher names version 4.0 and links no text for it; published texts exist for 1.0 and 2.0, none was found for 4.0, and that is recorded as unresolved rather than assumed away. The attribution obligation is common to every 'Namensnennung' version and is what is complied with here. CROSS-CHECKED under pin 14: the Statistische Aemter des Bundes und der Laender republish the same series per Bundesland at one decimal on statistikportal.de, attributed 'Quelle: Bundesnetzagentur'; ALL SIXTEEN AGREE with the column used here rounded to that precision, and their Deutschland figure is 11.7. ADMISSIBILITY CLASS A: the Bundesland is BNetzA's OWN published unit for this series, so nothing is reallocated and nothing is fitted. D-23 at n = 16 against a floor of 10, and 16 distinct values at the precision the publisher publishes. GRANULARITY CROSSING (Convention #22): the Bundesland value is assigned UNIFORMLY to the substations within it, with no allocator, the join being the NUTS 1 code, which is the first three characters of the NUTS 3 code BY CONSTRUCTION OF THE CLASSIFICATION. 16 units over 106,053 of 108,016 records, 98.18 per cent; the 1,963 records carrying no province value get NOTHING under Convention #56 -- absent rather than defaulted, and NOT a national figure, which would be Class D over a fleet whose own decomposition is published. THE DEPARTURE THE PUBLISHER DECLARES AND THE FLAG OFFICER RULED ON, verbatim from the sheet: 'Es ist zu beruecksichtigen, dass der jeweilige Bundesland-SAIDIEnWG nur naeherungsweise deckungsgleich mit dem jeweiligen Bundesland ist' and 'Hat ein Netzbetreiber ein Netzgebiet das sich in mehr als einem Bundesland befindet, werden die Versorgungsunterbrechungen dem Bundesland zugerechnet, in dem der Netzbetreiber seinen Firmensitz hat'. SO A BUNDESLAND FIGURE IS THE FIGURE FOR THE OPERATORS HEADQUARTERED THERE, NOT FOR THE TERRITORY'S OWN GEOGRAPHY. Berlin, Hamburg and Bremen are the three city-states where the two coincide most closely. The question whether such a figure may be assigned to the substations in that Bundesland was reserved to the flag officer on 5 October and ANSWERED BY HIM ON 18 OCTOBER 2026: yes. It is carried here rather than resolved, so a reader meets the limitation on the record and not only in a document about it. C2, C3 and C4 ARE DECLARED ABSENT, not zero and not substituted, under the flag officer's D-6 ruling of 5 October 2026: BNetzA publishes SAIDI and ASIDI and NO SAIFI, and its per-incident file VersUnterbr2024.xlsx carries the quantity and no geography column at all; C3's ceiling is an ARERA construct and BNetzA sets none. SO GERMANY'S C RESTS ON 0.40 OF ITS OWN DEFINITION, admitted by the primary-metric rule of 17 October and by nothing else: C1 is C's declared primary metric in engine.PRIMARY_METRIC, and the mass floor at 0.45 -- which refused exactly this one case in the whole architecture -- applies now only to a component declaring no primary. composite_coverage_intra is what states what the claim is worth.

_provenance_legend.order: C V I E S T
_provenance_legend.a: absent — the component key is not on the record
_provenance_legend.L: linked — the record carries a per-component source for this component. AMENDED 2 October 2026: the source now OUTRANKS the value. Before, a declared source was overruled whenever the value happened to equal a generator's output or to be zero, which it did on 121 positions across eleven jurisdictions.
_provenance_legend.u: UNLINKED — reproduces neither generator AND carries no source. NOT the same as derived.
_provenance_legend._cprov_coincidence: present only where a position is L AND the value would also have reproduced a generator, or is zero. The component letters, in C V I E S T order. A seventh marker symbol was considered and refused: every consumer of _cprov would have had to learn it, and the fact is rarer than one record in five thousand.

_composite_coverage_legend: Convention #21. The summed COMPONENT_WEIGHTS of the components whose _cprov slot reads L — that is, the components carrying a RECORDED SOURCE. It is not a count of components derived from a measurement; a source string is a provenance claim and not a measurement claim, and the two were conflated in this field's original definition. A completeness claim, NOT a truth claim: a record may read high and still be substantially a hash of its own name. Presenting coverage as a quality score is banned. The separation of presence, provenance and derivation is before the flag officer in doctrine/AMENDMENT_20261001_convention_21_the_three_coverages.md

_re_norm_basis_legend.what: which normalisation basis this record's published Re_norm reproduces from. It declares the basis and changes no value.
_re_norm_basis_legend.D: the declared NEUTRAL DEFAULT: Re_raw 1.0 and Re_norm 0.0
_re_norm_basis_legend.G: reproduces from the DECLARED GLOBAL bounds clip((Re_raw-0.920)/(1.787-0.920),0,1)
_re_norm_basis_legend.C: reproduces from THIS FLEET'S OWN bounds, stated below
_re_norm_basis_legend.U: UNRESOLVED: reproduces from neither. NOT the same as wrong - no claim is made here that the stored value is incorrect, only that the basis it was computed against is not one this instrument can identify.
_re_norm_basis_legend.scoring: NO scoring field is written. Re_norm itself is untouched. The instrument diffs every scoring field on every record against what it read and exits 3 if any moved.
_re_norm_basis_legend.why: The estate declares one formula and at least three are in production: 8 fleets wholly on the declared bounds, 4 wholly on their own, 27 mixed within themselves, and 8.9 per cent of 619,171 non-default records reproducing from neither. Which basis the axis SHOULD use is a ruling, not a repair; this makes the answer readable in the meantime.
